$comment: ZIEE's declaration of its LIVE gallery-harness copies, consumed by
It lives at the repo ROOT, and its `file` paths are relative to THIS file,
so both ui workspaces point at one declaration. Duplicating the list per
workspace would re-create exactly the drift the guard exists to catch.
A copy listed here is one some npm script actually EXECUTES. A dead copy is
not listed - it is deleted (CODING_GUIDELINES SS15).
Declare only WHERE each copy is and WHAT it is. There is deliberately NO
per-copy `cores` list: which cores a copy must carry is derived from its
`role` by @ziee/gallery. A per-copy list let a core be dropped from ONE copy
and silently stop being checked - the very bug this guard exists to catch.
`role`: runtime-health PRODUCES the run manifest/verdict; gate-ui CONSUMES
them, so each side is checked for the call IT must make.
